snippet.title: Jesus Take The Wheel - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
We've just shadow dropped our latest project on Steam! It's a small co-op game where two players share control of the same car. One handles the pedals, and the other steers. Chaos quickly ensues. 

CHECK IT OUT HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4444250/Jesus_Take_The_Wheel/
